		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mdcw_cw_topbar_container"
		dirty = global.mdcw_cw_gui_dirty

		ai_enabled = { always = no }

		visible = {
			is_ai = no
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			NOT = { has_country_flag = hide_money }
		}

		effects = {
			mdcw_cw_topbar_bg_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_open }
					clr_country_flag = mdcw_cw_open
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_open
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { mdcw_cw_tab < 1 }
								check_variable = { mdcw_cw_tab > 3 }
							}
						}
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_tab = 1 }
					}
					mdcw_cw_refresh_player_view = yes
				}
				mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
			}
		}
	}

	mdcw_cw_prog_in_list = {

	mdcw_cw_assistance_send = {

	mdcw_cw_pps_send = {
		context_type = diplomatic_action
		window_name = "mdcw_cw_pps_send_window"

		effects = {
			mdcw_cw_ps_prev_click = {
				ROOT = {
					subtract_from_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party < 0 } }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = 23 }
					}
				}
			}
			mdcw_cw_ps_next_click = {
				ROOT = {
					add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party > 23 } }
						set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
